website_summary.name: HTML CodeCraft Studio
website_summary.description: The website presents a sleek, dual-pane interface with a live HTML editor on the left and a real-time preview pane on the right, featuring a minimalist design with honeydew backgrounds and dark olive green accents.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a clean and organized layout divided into two main sections: an HTML editor on the left and a preview pane on the right. The editor displays the HTML code with syntax highlighting, while the preview pane shows the rendered output of the code. The top navigation bar includes buttons for switching modes, saving projects/templates, accessing guides, and toggling dark mode. The bottom section provides options for managing projects and template pages. The overall design uses a honeydew background color with dark olive green highlights for buttons and icons, creating a visually appealing and functional workspace.
website_summary.functionality:
The website offers several key functionalities: 
- A live HTML editor with syntax highlighting that allows users to write and edit HTML code.
- A real-time preview pane that instantly reflects changes made in the editor.
- Options to switch between HTML code and text editing modes.
- Features for saving projects and templates.
- A guide for users to learn more about the editor’s capabilities.
- A console for debugging purposes.
- Project management tools for organizing multiple HTML documents, images, and other files.
- Dark mode toggle for better visibility in low-light conditions.

functionality_testing.name: Editor Pane Textarea Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that modifying the text in the Editor pane textarea updates the Preview pane content.
functionality_testing.preconditions:
The Editor pane displays the initial text `

Hello World!

`.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The Preview pane should display "Welcome!" immediately after the text is modified in the Editor pane. 7. Next Steps : Modify the text in the Editor pane textarea to "Welcome!".
procedure: Type "Welcome!" in the Editor pane textarea.
Verify that the Preview pane updates to display "Welcome!".

functionality_testing.name: Refresh Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Refresh Button updates the preview.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The new paragraph is added in the Editor pane.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The preview should display the new paragraph.
procedure: Click on the Refresh Button.
Verify that the preview updates to show the new paragraph.

functionality_testing.name: Switch to HTML Mode Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Switch to HTML Mode button toggles the editor back to HTML mode while retaining the content.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The editor is currently in Text mode with the content "Hello World!".
functionality_testing.expected_results:
The editor should display the content in HTML format (`

Hello World!

`).
procedure: Click on the Switch to HTML Mode button.
Verify that the editor switches to HTML mode and displays the content as HTML code.

functionality_testing.name: Switch to Text Mode Test

functionality_testing.preconditions: The editor is currently in HTML mode.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The editor should display the content in plain text format. 7. Next Steps : Click the "Switch to Text Mode" button to proceed with the task.
